access_denial_policy: On HTTP403 or denied CONNECT403, stop and pause automation; no provider, account, IP or proxy fallback.
active_collector_policy: If the existing collector lock is held, do not start another collector or issue a probe.
authorization: Explicit user request: Continue à relancer; preserve prior work.
backoff_policy: For repeated 429s, wait at least max(Retry-After, 2h, twice the last retry delay), capped at 24h for the local backoff only; never cap a longer server Retry-After. Skip not-yet-due runs without HTTP.
completion_policy: Pause automation when no network gaps remain; bounded-incomplete histories require separate coverage work. No model, label promotion, costs or main-branch merge.
public_snapshot_policy: Commit checkpoints/deltas, normalized prior-block evidence, metadata and current status; raw address plans/histories stay excluded.
route: Original provider/system proxy configuration and verified TLS only
success_policy: Continue only fixed latest error/unattempted IDs. Do not requery complete or bounded-incomplete histories. Every new retry pass pins all previous protocols/checkpoints/stops; no silent retry within a pass.
